WITH current_rdv AS (
    SELECT
        rv.id,
        rv.reference,
        rv.creneau_id AS old_slot_id,
        rv.statut
    FROM rendez_vous rv
    WHERE rv.token_gestion = $1::uuid
    FOR UPDATE
),
new_slot AS (
    SELECT
        c.id,
        c.service_id,
        c.site_id,
        c.debut,
        c.fin,
        c.capacite,
        c.places_reservees
    FROM creneaux c
    WHERE c.id = $2::uuid
    FOR UPDATE
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT
        r.id AS rdv_id,
        r.reference,
        r.old_slot_id,
        n.id AS new_slot_id
    FROM current_rdv r
    JOIN new_slot n ON TRUE
    WHERE r.statut = 'CONFIRME'
      AND r.old_slot_id <> n.id
      AND n.places_reservees < n.capacite
),
reserve_new AS (
    UPDATE creneaux c
    SET places_reservees = c.places_reservees + 1
    FROM eligible e
    WHERE c.id = e.new_slot_id
    RETURNING c.id
),
release_old AS (
    UPDATE creneaux c
    SET places_reservees = GREATEST(c.places_reservees - 1, 0)
    FROM eligible e
    WHERE c.id = e.old_slot_id
    RETURNING c.id
),
update_rdv AS (
    UPDATE rendez_vous rv
    SET
        creneau_id = e.new_slot_id,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    FROM eligible e
    WHERE rv.id = e.rdv_id
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reserve_new)
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM release_old)
    RETURNING
        rv.id,
        rv.reference,
        rv.statut,
        rv.creneau_id
)
SELECT
    u.id,
    u.reference,
    u.statut,
    c.id AS creneau_id,
    c.debut,
    c.fin,
    c.capacite,
    c.places_reservees,
    c.capacite - c.places_reservees AS places_disponibles,
    s.code AS service,
    si.code AS site
FROM update_rdv u
JOIN creneaux c ON c.id = u.creneau_id
JOIN services s ON s.id = c.service_id
JOIN sites si ON si.id = c.site_id;
